Official hosted Streamable HTTP MCP at https://api.x.com/mcp (search, users, bookmarks, trends, Articles). Read-only: app-only Bearer token from X Developer Console. Full access: OAuth 2.0 PKCE via @xdevplatform/xurl local bridge (Developer Portal app, redirect http://localhost:8080/callback, CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET). Docs: https://x-preview.mintlify.app/tools/mcp. Revise existing guides/x/ on branch guide/issue-15-x (draft PR #33). Enrollment (#enroll-developer-account) and create app (#create-x-app): hedge—keep steps; do not invent field/submit/create labels; enrollment success = Developer Console with New App visible; keep one-time credential warning on create. Prerequisites API credits: required; point to Developer Console billing/credits without purchase walkthrough. Copy Bearer Token: copy-now only; drop regenerate-if-missed. Add server (#add-server-in-speakeasy): catalog search term as code span `X`; keep catalog vs custom remote URL conditional until Speakeasy catalog presence verified. Open questions: unknown/omit for console label details and catalog presence—keep hedges.
